sampleSub.title: Sample Marketing Copy Submission
sampleSub.content: Nova product brochure: Battery life is up to 18 hours under specified test conditions.

limitations: Limited analysis: no AI provider is configured (LLM_API_KEY is empty), so only deterministic rules were applied. Claims written as paraphrases, and paraphrased support in approved facts, cannot be recognised. A result of 'no findings' does not mean the content has no claims.

findings.claim_text: Nova product brochure: Battery life is up to 18 hours under specified test conditions.
findings.explanation: No suitable approved evidence was found for this claim. Unsupported does not mean the claim is false; it means the approved knowledge base does not substantiate it.
findings.recommended_action: Remove the claim, reword it to match an approved fact, or ask the owner to add and approve evidence for it.
